subject: Vendor onboarding: Tidewell Logistics - payment channel activation & PO handling
messages:
From: Asha Raman <asha.raman@tidewelllogistics.com>
To: jonas_weber@redwood-inference.com, priyom_das@redwood-inference.com, marissa_cole@redwood-inference.com
Date: 2028-05-12T09:05:00-07:00
Subject: Vendor onboarding packet: bank info + PO mapping questions

Hi Jonas / Marissa / Priyom,

Thanks for the quick intro — excited to get Tidewell set up as a vendor. Attached are the completed bank details form and our W-9. High level: we can accept ACH or wires; preferred settlement is ACH (origination ACH debit from Redwood), but we can do wire on exception.

A couple asks from our side so we can align finance systems:
- Can you confirm the field you will use for PO linkage in your remittance file? (We typically expect a "PO" column.)
- Any specific invoice label/substring you need for automated matching?
- Do you run a micro-deposit verification or require an ACH test? If so, what amounts and timing do you prefer?
- Please confirm the remit advice email you want us to send after each payout.

We're attaching: Tidewell_Bank_Form_Fillable.pdf (filled), Tidewell_W9.pdf.

If helpful we can hop on a 20-min call tomorrow to walk through the CSV mapping.

Thanks,
Asha Raman
Operations Lead, Tidewell Logistics
asha.raman@tidewelllogistics.com
(415) 555-0192

Attachments: Tidewell_Bank_Form_Fillable.pdf (pdf), Tidewell_W9.pdf (pdf)

From: jonas_weber@redwood-inference.com
To: Asha Raman <asha.raman@tidewelllogistics.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood-inference.com, priya_natarajan@redwood-inference.com
Date: 2028-05-12T11:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding packet: bank info + PO mapping questions

Hi Asha — thanks for the forms, received them and uploaded to our vendor portal. A few confirmations from our side:

- Remit reference: please include the PO number in the remittance description, formatted as PO#<number>. Our payops system will also look for a column named "po_number" in remittance CSVs for automated reconciliation.
- Invoice label: please include the vendor short name "TIDEWELL" and the PO (e.g., TIDEWELL - PO12345) as the invoice title when submitting for payment — that speeds matching.
- Micro-deposit: we prefer to do two micro-deposits for ACH verification. We'll send two small credits (USD 0.12 and USD 0.37) to verify the account and will notify you once posted; please confirm within 5 business days that the amounts match. If you prefer to provide a bank letter instead (bank_letter_tidewell.pdf), we can accept that as a verification alternative.
- Remit advice: please send remittance notifications to remit@redwood-inference.com and cc: ap@tidewelllogistics.com for visibility.

Internal note: Marissa and Priya — can you pick this up in the vendor portal and schedule the micro-deposit test? I'll attach the PO template mapping we use (see drive link).

Best,
Jonas Weber
Sr. Partnerships Manager | Redwood Inference
jonas_weber@redwood-inference.com

Thanks Jonas — confirming next steps from our side.

- Attached sample remit CSV (tidewell_remit_sample.csv) with example columns: "po_number", "invoice_number", "amount", "date", "remit_reference". We're happy to modify if you need an extra column.
- Micro-deposit plan: we will accept the two micro-deposits you described and confirm when we see them. Bank has provided a bank letter; attaching bank_letter_tidewell.pdf for your records.
- Remit notifications: we'll send remits to remit@redwood-inference.com and cc ap@tidewelllogistics.com.

If you can confirm when the micro-deposits go out we will watch and reply with verification. Also: our procurement team asks for the Redwood PO prefix if you use one — is there a short prefix we should expect?

Thanks,
Asha

Date: 2028-05-16T14:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding packet: bank info + PO mapping questions

Hi Asha — quick status update from Redwood payops:

- Micro-deposits went out this morning (USD 0.12 and USD 0.37) from our ACH sandbox account ending in 2241. Please confirm the amounts when you see them.
- We verified the bank letter you provided and attached the final activation confirmation to this thread (activation_confirmation.pdf).
- PO prefix: Redwood uses the prefix "RW-" for our internal PO numbers; the full PO will look like RW-12345. Please map any incoming remits with "po_number" values that include the RW- prefix or plain numeric PO values — our reconciliation accepts both.
- Remit advice: once live please route remittance CSVs to remit@redwood-inference.com. We will run the first reconciliation on Monday and confirm settlement.

Next steps: once you confirm the micro-deposit amounts we will mark the vendor as ACTIVE and push the vendor payment terms into the portal (Net 30 by default). I'll also follow up with a DocuSign link for the vendor agreement; please sign that to finalize the profile.

Thanks for moving quickly on this — welcome aboard.

Regards,
Marissa Cole
Vendor Onboarding Lead | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood-inference.com

Attachments: activation_confirmation.pdf (pdf)
